# Step - as_date

`as_date` · `asDate` · category: [Dates and times](../../traversal/step_reference.md#dates-and-times)

Text or epoch milliseconds to a datetime (TinkerPop asDate()), or to a GType.

## Forms

```text
as_date()
as_date(arg1: GType)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(0).as_date().next().year   // 1970
```
